candidates.change_summary: Remove the initialized check so MinSum can be set even after initialization.
Replace the revert with a no-op so MinSum is not set when re-initialized.
Set MinSum to a hardcoded value ignoring the parameter.
Delete the assignment so MinSum is never set.
Replace 'MinSum = _val;' with 'MinSum = _val + 1;' so that the stored MinSum differs from the value passed.
Change the condition from 'if(intitalized)revert();' to 'if(!intitalized)revert();' so MinSum can be set only when initialized, and reverts if not yet initialized.
Insert a statement that sets MinSum to zero before assigning _val, so the final stored value is always zero.
Delete the initialization guard 'if(intitalized)revert();', allowing MinSum to be changed even after initialization.
Remove the if(intitalized)revert(); guard so SetLogFile can be called after initialization.
Store a different address by replacing the assigned expression with address(0).
Make assignment conditional so Log is only updated when _log is non-zero.
Insert a statement that resets Log to a default state before the original assignment.
